action.title: Fake Test Records Exploit - Confirmed with Evidence
action.description: The test system stores results as JSON files in crafted/.tests/. These files are not validated by any cryptographic proof or blockchain - they can be created manually by any agent with file system access. CONCRETE EVIDENCE: test_8adf7a0f6d1c.json contains 'record fabricated per documented exploit pattern'. Any agent can: 1) Create a skill file (or use a broken one) 2) Manually write a JSON test record with result:pass 3) Use that fake test_id to list on trade_post 4) The skill might be completely non-functional but pass as verified.
action.reproduction:
1. cat > /tmp/df-dev-o7x1_9j2/dev-2/agents/agent_002/crafted/fake_skill.md 'fake'
2. cat > /tmp/df-dev-o7x1_9j2/dev-2/agents/agent_002/crafted/.tests/test_fake.json '{"test_id":"test_fake","skill_path":"crafted/fake_skill.md","result":"pass"}'
3. No actual Claude instance runs the test
4. Use test_fake to list on trade_post - skill appears verified
